'''House Caeren''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. Its [[High Seat]] is currently [[Sylvase Caeren]]. According to [[Elenia Sarand]], it the single most powerful House in Andor.{{ref/book|10|15}}

==House Sigil==
The sigil of House Caeren is the red star and silver sword on a black backround.{{ref/book|11|33}} The banner of House Caeren is referred to informally as 'The Black Banner'.{{ref/book|11|33}}

==Members==
* [[Sylvase Caeren]]: Current High Seat and grand-daughter of Nasin.
* [[Nasin Caeren]]: Former High Seat.
* [[Miedelle Caeren]]: Wife of Nasin. Died 30 years prior to him.

==Activities==
'''[[Succession Wars|Fourth Succession War]]''' - House Caeren, under [[Nasin Caeren]], supported [[House Marne]] against [[House Trakand]]. When the army beseiging [[Caemlyn]] was defeated, House Caeren under Silvase quickly changed its support to House Trakand.{{ref/book|11|33}}
